draft_scope.intent: Build Studio (pillar #18) as the Handshake-native unified creative suite in native Rust: full deduped feature parity with Photoshop(+Camera Raw)/Illustrator/InDesign/Affinity-suite/Figma-family across raster/vector/layout/typography/color/effects/design-systems/prototyping/raw/interop/automation/whiteboard, offline with no external creative-app dependency, wired to Handshake pillars (EventLedger/PostgreSQL, CRDT, sandbox->validation->PromotionGate, three-tier diagnostics, Argus, Loom, FEMS, Job Runtime, DCC, UserManual), model-visible+steerable in backend and frontend, with parallel multi-file/multi-model workflows, a propose-work system, per-file history/undo with revert-of-undo, and a headless/quiet operation law.
draft_scope.scope_sketch: IN: handshake_core::studio module + studio-engine crate (RasterEngine/VectorEngine/LayoutEngine/TextEngine/ColorEngine/RenderEngine traits), StudioDocument unified model + 38 canonical primitives, studio_* PostgreSQL tables + dated migrations, STUDIO_* EventLedger variants, StudioValidationDescriptor, StudioModelAdapter + MCP command surface, StudioEditProposal propose-work path, per-file StudioHistoryEntry undo/redo, native egui/wgpu/AccessKit operator surface with Argus targets, dual-audience UserManual entries, import/export + format-compat fixtures. OUT: source-app menu-tree clones, pixel-perfect UI clone, vendor cloud services, vendor product naming, a new invented interchange format, provider generative-AI as a core dependency (adapter-only).
draft_scope.acceptance_criteria: Every Section 14 normative MUST claimed by an MT is proven with runtime evidence (executable product runtime or Handshake-managed resource boundary), not scaffold-only; StudioDocument authority resolves through PostgreSQL/EventLedger with no SQLite; model-authored edits pass sandbox->validation->PromotionGate; every operator-visible surface has Argus proof + dual-audience UserManual entry; HBR matrix (INT/SWARM/VIS/QUIET/MAN/STOP) all PROVED/NOT_APPLICABLE-with-reason before closeout; parity coverage traces to the deduped Section 14 feature catalog.
draft_scope.risks_unknowns: Very large surface (hundreds of MTs); CRDT for large raster documents; GPU contention across parallel render jobs; undo semantics across CRDT+EventLedger dual state; headless-GPU screenshot readback crash class 0xc0000005 (fall back to AccessKit-tree assertions on headless hosts); internal_diagnostics/Palmistry DEFERRED until WP-KERNEL-012/016 ship. Open contract points in [STU-CON-006] (redo depth, event granularity/coalescing, auto-accept policy, raster authority storage shape, FR-EVT-STUDIO-* registration, plugin capability schema) must be resolved by refinement before the implementing MTs harden.
draft_scope.governance_artifact_stance: Machine-contract-first (packet.json + MT-*.json authority; Markdown projection only). Studio research corpus is non-normative provenance per [STU-SECTION-002]; Section 14 is sole authority.

microtask_plan.decomposition_authority: Section 14 domains; foundation MTs first (kernel binding, canonical contracts, document model, tables/migrations, EventLedger variants, engine traits), then per-domain feature MTs (each feature-group -> one narrow MT), then cross-cutting MTs (model API/MCP, propose-work, history/undo, headless/quiet, operator unification, UserManual, validation/HBR harnesses).
microtask_plan.granularity_rule: No upper MT-count bias; each MT narrow enough for a small/fast coding model and independent per-MT review + crash/session recovery; split when an MT would mix unrelated authority boundaries, broad code-surface families, independent proof commands, or unrelated failure modes.
microtask_plan.estimated_mt_count: hundreds (comparable to Tailor Section 13 which used 653); authored in domain batches under KERNEL_BUILDER/Activation review
